title: Materials Lateness Allowance When a Ridgeline Special Order Supplies the Installation
content:
Where the materials of a Ridgeline Installation Services contract come through a special order of Ridgeline Special Order Services linked to the contract, a modest lateness of those materials earns a materials lateness allowance on the final settlement payment.

**Clause.** Materials lateness allowance on the final settlement payment: the materials lateness is the calendar days from the linked special order's promised ready date to its ready date, and the special order program's vendor delay threshold marks the lateness that program's own delay remedies take over; when the materials lateness is more than the long-lateness days of 14 and no more than that threshold, the long lateness allowance of 150.00 applies; when it is above 0 and no more than both the long-lateness days and that threshold, the short lateness allowance of 75.00 applies; otherwise there is no materials lateness allowance.

The allowance is deducted from the final settlement payment.

## Records that decide the allowance

The special order of Ridgeline Special Order Services linked to the contract as its materials: its program, its promised ready date and its ready date. The vendor delay threshold is the figure of the linked order's special order program. When the linked order has no ready date recorded, there is no lateness to count and no allowance.

## Vendor delay threshold by special order program

| Ridgeline Special Order Services program of the linked order | Vendor delay threshold (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | 14 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | 10 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | 10 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | 21 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | 21 |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | 14 |

On a linked order whose threshold is 21 days, a lateness of 1 to 14 days earns 75.00 and a lateness of 15 to 21 days earns 150.00; on one whose threshold is 14 days, a lateness of 1 to 14 days earns 75.00 and no lateness earns 150.00; on one whose threshold is 10 days, a lateness of 1 to 10 days earns 75.00.

## Allowance table

| Materials lateness | Compared with the vendor delay threshold | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 0 days or ready early | any | none |
| 1 to 14 days | no more than the threshold | 75.00 |
| more than 14 days | no more than the threshold | 150.00 |
| any lateness | more than the threshold | none |

## Worked figures (hypothetical special order program thresholds)

| Promised ready | Ready | Lateness | Threshold | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 May | 7 May | 6 days | 21 days | 75.00 |
| 1 May | 15 May | 14 days | 21 days | 75.00 |
| 1 May | 16 May | 15 days | 21 days | 150.00 |
| 1 May | 23 May | 22 days | 21 days | none |
| 1 May | 13 May | 12 days | 10 days | none |
